usage: ‘進化’ (zeon3 faa3) is mainly used as a noun to describe the process of evolution in biology.
It often appears in scientific discussions or educational contexts related to the development or changes over time of species.
You can use ‘進化’ to talk about both the concept of evolution itself and specific evolutionary changes in organisms.
It can also be used metaphorically to describe gradual improvement or development in other areas, not just biology.
When using ‘進化’, it usually follows verbs like '研究' (research), '理解' (understand), or '觀察' (observe).
